pages.text: [#](53341a)The four lasting infusions begin in the kettle, not the circle.[#]()
pages.title: Infusion Sources

pages.text: [#](53341a)Each source uses **Redstone Soup** as a base and asks a nearby altar for **4000 power**, preparing the essence for one branch of permanent transformation.[#]()
[#](53341a)The Otherwhere and Infernal brews also accept their splash-potion twins, if that is what you have to hand.[#]()
[#](53341a)The Light infusion: Redstone Soup with Long Invisibility, Long Fire Resistance, a Fire Protection Poppet, a torch, and Tongue of Dog.[#]()
pages.title: Ghost of the Light

pages.text: [#](53341a)The Overworld infusion: Redstone Soup with Long Regeneration, an Enchanted Golden Apple, an Attuned Stone, a Mandrake Root, and a Rowan Sapling.[#]()
pages.title: Soul of the World

pages.text: [#](53341a)The Otherwhere infusion: Redstone Soup with a Long Swiftness potion, two Ender Eyes, a Drop of Luck, and Wool of Bat.[#]()
pages.title: Spirit of Otherwhere

pages.text: [#](53341a)The Infernal infusion: Redstone Soup with a Strong Harming potion, a Voodoo Poppet, a Demon Heart, Refined Evil, and a Blaze Rod.[#]()
pages.title: Infernal Animus
